rating_basis: Marelli Motori LV generators are Class H insulated as standard and rated in kVA at 0.8 pf lagging, 40 C ambient (IEC 60034), up to 1000 m, IP23 with no filters; kW = kVA x 0.8. 'Continuous duty' (Marelli also calls it prime: variable load, unlimited hours) is given at three temperature rises: 125/40 (Class H rise), 105/40 (Class F rise), 80/40 (Class B rise), each with 10% overload for 1 h in every 6 h. 'Stand-by' is for emergency supply during a utility outage, with no overload allowed, and comes in two figures: 150/40 (150 C rise at 40 C ambient, the ISO 8528-3 peak continuous rating, used here as standby_kva) and 163/27 (163 C rise at 27 C ambient, Marelli's own emergency-peak rating, which ISO does not define). Deratings: altitude 0.96 at <1500 m, 0.93 at <2000 m, 0.90 at <2500 m, 0.86 at <3000 m; ambient 0.96 at 45 C, 0.93 at 50 C, 0.90 at 55 C (1.04 at 30 C). kVA figures differ by connected voltage (380/416/440/460/480 V are tabulated separately).
